subject: AWS listing: credibility claims, evidence pack & field demo slate
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Harper <danielle.harper@acme-ai.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: AWS listing: credibility claims, evidence pack & field demo slate

Hi Danielle —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Per our conversation, we pulled together the draft evidence pack and a proposed field demo slate that we think will help buyers on the AWS product page feel confident quickly (and give your sales team consistent demo talking points). Attached are:

- acme_evidence_binder_v2.pdf — security & compliance excerpts, SSO diagram, SOC/Sec attestations (redacted PII)
- product_hero_3up.png — three hero variants for the marketplace hero slot
- pricing_table.csv — suggested SKU/pricing and private offer footnotes

High-level asks from our side before we open the listing:
1) Confirm which hero variant you prefer (1/2/3) — we can cut localized versions after final pick.
2) Approve the evidence binder sections we listed under "Trust & Security" (page 3+). If you want additional artifacts (e.g., IDS logs export), say so.
3) Clarify trial entitlement: is Acme comfortable with a 14-day private-offer trial mapped to the "starter" SKU, or do you want usage-limited free-tier? This affects language under "Trial & Pricing" and private-offer setup.

Proposed next steps:
- If we get quick answers, we can finalize marketplace copy and submit for AWS review by 10/15.
- Sales enablement: we drafted a 3-bullet demo slate for field reps (see page 5 of the binder). Would you like Redwood to run a 30-minute rehearsal with your AE leads next week?

Thanks — attached is the binder and the copy snippets in-line in case Gmail blocks attachments.

Best,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Partner Programs, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: acme_evidence_binder_v2.pdf] [Attachment: product_hero_3up.png] [Attachment: pricing_table.csv]

From: Danielle Harper <danielle.harper@acme-ai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@acme.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: AWS listing: credibility claims, evidence pack & field demo slate

Naomi —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the tidy binder. Quick answers inline:

- Hero: Variant 2 resonates best with our field (calls out low-latency + enterprise controls).
- Evidence binder: page 3 looks good; can you remove the internal CI run IDs (we need to keep that off public docs). Otherwise fine.
- Trial: we prefer a usage-limited free-tier (10k tokens / 14 days) rather than a full private-offer credit. Private-offer trial makes procurement messy for some of our pilot customers.

We're OK with a rehearsal — can your team run Tuesday 10/13 at 10am PT? I'll loop in our AE lead for the session.

One ask: our procurement team flagged the pricing_table footnote 2 (regarding "burst billing") as ambiguous. Can you and Kimberly give a clean one-liner that maps to AWS consumption semantics?

Thanks,
Danielle
Director, Cloud Partnerships — Acme AI
[Attachment: acme_internal_notes.txt]

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: AWS listing: credibility claims, evidence pack & field demo slate

Forwarding Acme's quick feedback — key follow-ups below.

1) Hero variant chosen: Variant 2 (Acme). Marissa, can you run a copy refresh to emphasize "sub-50ms response" and add the enterprise controls callout? Keep length under 160 chars for the hero line.

2) Evidence binder: Acme asked to strip internal CI run IDs. Jonas, please scrub identifiers and produce a redacted PDF (same filename v3).

3) Trial language: Acme wants a usage-limited free-tier (10k tokens / 14 days). That changes the marketplace "Trial & Pricing" blurb. Kimberly, can you draft a single-sentence footnote that clarifies: "Trial grants a usage allowance (10k tokens) expiring after 14 days; additional usage billed per the SKU rate." Also add a one-line clarification for private-offers.

4) Procurement flagged burst billing wording. Kimberly, see Danielle's note — can you provide a non-technical one-liner that maps to AWS meters ("billing for bursts only applies when usage exceeds reserved throughput and is metered per second") so procurement can sign off?

5) Rehearsal: Acme proposed Tue 10/13 10am PT. Naomi — please confirm and include the AE lead contact.

I'll draft the updated marketplace hero + 2 short bullets for the listing once I have the scrubbed binder and finalized trial/footnote text.

—Naomi

> On 2026-10-11 11:02, Danielle Harper wrote:
> Naomi —
> 
> Appreciate the fast turnaround and the tidy binder. Quick answers inline:
> 
> - Hero: Variant 2 resonates best with our field ...
> - Evidence binder: page 3 looks good; can you remove the internal CI run IDs ...
> - Trial: we prefer a usage-limited free-tier ...
> 
> One ask: our procurement team flagged the pricing_table footnote 2 ...

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: AWS listing: credibility claims, evidence pack & field demo slate

All —

Thanks for the breakdown. Quick deliverables from infra/product/legal side:

- Pricing footnote (for listing & pricing_table.csv): "Trial grants a one-time usage allowance of 10,000 tokens, valid for 14 days from activation; subsequent usage is billed at the published per-token SKU rate. Private-offers may be configured to credit the same allowance under the customer's offer terms."

- Burst billing clarification (non-technical): "Burst billing applies only when usage temporarily exceeds your plan's reserved throughput; excess usage is metered per second and charged at the listed overage rate."

- Evidence binder: Jonas will produce acme_evidence_binder_v3_redacted.pdf with CI/run IDs removed and a short index. Targeting 10/12 EOD PST.

- Hero copy (Marissa): I'll review the 160-char hero and two bullets once you drop the variant 2 PNG. Keep the hero claim to measured latency language (e.g., "sub-50ms median inference") and avoid absolute guarantees.

Rehearsal: Tuesday 10/13 10am PT works for me. Naomi, please include the Acme AE lead and send calendar invite.

Kimberly Park
Head, Partner Pricing & GTM Ops — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pricing_table_final_notes.txt]
